name: Close Behind
designNote: Aha: let the Tarnish chase Sol all the way round the loop and past the mirror shrine, then line Sol up with Lune just as it closes in. The flip puts it to sleep right behind him, and Lune's newly woken Tarnish is penned in its corner.
hints: The Tarnish follows Sol everywhere. Lead it on a long walk.
Walk Sol round the loop with the Tarnish behind him, then line up with Lune as it catches up.
